items.basis: The candidate claims zero failure modes while proposing an oxidizing biocide in a 32-38 C recirculated steel mill cooling loop, where dissolved iron and suspended scale particles will consume the oxidant before it reaches biofilm, yet the record asserts control without accounting for this demand. GROUNDED_IN: RECORD "Known failure modes (claimed by the generator): (none claimed)"

The boundary condition requires dosing inside the existing discharge permit, but continuous 0.3 ppm oxidizing biocide plus weekly 8 ppm dispersant slugs introduces persistent halogenated or oxidative residuals into the blowdown stream that may exceed permit limits depending on the specific chemistry class, which is left unspecified. GROUNDED_IN: RECORD "Boundary conditions: dosing inside the existing discharge permit"
No evidence bundle is held, so no internal contradiction between data points can be demonstrated from the candidate's own record. GROUNDED_IN: EVIDENCE (none held)

The predicted total clogging rate of 1.4 events per campaign relies on routine screening to handle the scale-particle share, but the baseline problem definition explicitly identifies scale particles as a co-driver of progressive nozzle clogging alongside biological growth, meaning the candidate only addresses half the stated failure mechanism. GROUNDED_IN: RECORD "progressive nozzle clogging from scale particles and biological growth"

ORP control of a 0.3 ppm oxidizing biocide in a recirculated hot-rolling cooling loop with high suspended solids and variable makeup water conductivity is notoriously unstable, yet the candidate specifies ORP control as the regulation method without defining probe placement or maintenance intervals. GROUNDED_IN: RECORD "continuous 0.3 ppm actinic biocide with ORP control"

The testable prediction requires monthly header-wall swab cultures to show a 2-order CFU reduction, but the record provides no baseline CFU count from which to compute a 2-order reduction, rendering the metric mathematically undefined against its own claims. GROUNDED_IN: RECORD "monthly header-wall swab cultures show a 2-order CFU reduction"
